ValidationRule.description: SecureSync Setup Date must be today's or past date. It cannot be the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: DP New Customer Setup" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c )) && DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c ) > TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c )) || DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c )) && DATEVALUE(SecureSync_Setup_Date__c ) > TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SecureSync Setup Date must be today's or past date. It cannot be the Future.
